headline: Seven days without a sync now outranks any session - run the push by hand, then take the road while the sea is shut.
body:
Thirteen push windows, nothing landed. The sync has not run since **2 October 21:31** - **154 hours** - so 3 to 8 October carry no file, no HRV, no steps, nothing passive. That is the pipeline, not you. But six mornings of describing it have changed nothing, so today it leads: **run `scripts/sync_and_push.ps1` by hand** and all six dates resolve at once.

Then ride. Road reads good in all three windows - gusts **37 / 39 / 30 km/h**, calmest after 16:00 at **18 C**. Give it **60-75 min at 131-150 bpm**, **26-28 km/h** on the flat, climbing capped at **155**. Steady, not hard: the last readiness I hold is a fired gate - **hrv 65 then 63 against a 69.1 mean** - and silence cannot clear it.

Sea is poor today. **Sunday 06:00-11:00 is a 19 km/h gust, open water good** - the first since 5 October, and Monday blows out at **72**. Swim Sunday early.

Did Thursday's swim happen? And the ankle - it is **26 days** since a run file.
